newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut weekly T-bill issue raises 1,058 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Beirut weekly T-bill issue raises 1,058 bln pounds.

text.p: Lebanon's weekly treasury bill issue of October 31 raised nearly 1,058 billion Lebanese pounds, the highest sum raised in a year, the finance ministry said on Monday.
This compares with a record 1,373 billion pounds for the November 3 issue last year.
The October 24, 1996 issue raised 604 billion pounds.

The Lebanese pound closed at 1,556 to the U.S. dollar on Monday from 1,556.5 a week earlier and 1,604.5 a year ago.
